note: Supersedes the v1 baselines in ui-baseline/*.png for Home, Details, Reports, EngineControl and History. Those predate the shared DateRangeCalendar migration and the approved UI polish batch, so they are retained for history only and are NOT the comparison target.

parts.1: Home status boxes no longer straddle the header gradient (marginTop -20 -> 16)
parts.2: Asset cards get a 1pt colors.line.strong border + shadows.card (shadow split into an inner cardClip so Android elevation is not clipped)
parts.3: Reports / View on Map buttons moved onto the 'Last Update' row, right-aligned, 40pt tall, 12pt semibold; date is the only shrinkable text
parts.4: Sensor + Quick Report tile grids rebuilt as explicit 3-wide rows with flex:1 so outer tiles land exactly on the section bar edges
parts.5: Sensor 'Select' area gets a 1pt colors.line.strong outline with the bar's corner radius
parts.6: Reports top-level sections standardised on the shared sizes.marginH (16) gutter; category tiles stay inset inside their 1pt border
parts.7: Engine Control top row: alignItems stretch + flex:1 on both boxes, gap 12 (was fixed 163pt width and a 2pt sliver)
parts.8: History: radii.md on Playback title strip, playback body, scrubber track/ticks, S9 section bar and the list container
